words.example: Improve the way numbers are called so people waiting can actually hear them.
words.exampleZh: 请改进叫号方式，让等候的人真的能听清。

words.example: Streamline the sign-in steps so a family is not standing there for long.
words.exampleZh: 请精简签到步骤，别让家属在那里站太久。

words.example: Simplify the leave form; a clerk on day one should manage to finish it.
words.exampleZh: 请简化请假表，让入职第一天的文员也能填完。

words.example: Standardize the way we label filed copies so every folder matches.
words.exampleZh: 请把归档副本的标注方式标准化，让每个文件夹都一致。

words.example: Ask whether the supplier can customize desk cards for that meeting room.
words.exampleZh: 问问供应商能否为那间会议室定制桌卡。

words.example: The port forward sends vendor support straight to the PACS admin host.
words.exampleZh: 这条端口转发把厂商支持直接送到 PACS 管理主机。

words.example: DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) holds the patient portal so the ward LAN stays separate.
words.exampleZh: DMZ（隔离区）放着患者门户，病区局域网因此和它隔开。

words.example: Staff open the intranet for policies, but patients never see that site.
words.exampleZh: 员工上内网查制度，患者看不到那个站点。

words.example: The extranet lets partner labs upload results without entering our core network.
words.exampleZh: 外联网让合作检验所上传结果，而不进入我们的核心网。

words.example: All clinic browsing leaves through the east internet breakout during office hours.
words.exampleZh: 上班时间，门诊上网流量都从东侧上网出口出去。
